description: An event published when a quiet window of a chaos run opens, once every effect is reverted, and when it closes
title: io.synadia.ntf.event.v1.chaos_window

id.description: Unique id of this event, a nuid

timestamp.description: The publisher's clock when the event was made, in RFC 3339 with nanoseconds

instance_id.description: The instance the event is about

source.description: The component that published the event

source_seq.description: Counts the source's events for the instance from 1 with no gaps

action.description: What happened to the quiet window

overrun.description: How far past the run's max_fault the window opened in nanoseconds, set on opened when the window opened late and absent otherwise
